features.title: First open: terms and welcome
features.summary: Accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, read the welcome pages and choose how to find the city.

steps.caption: On first open the app shows the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy before anything else.
Tick the acceptance box; "Aceitar e continuar" only works after a real tick.
Welcome page: the app shows the weekly ANP survey prices.
After the first sync the averages work without internet.
Contribution rules: photograph only public price boards and never invent prices.
Choose which ANP survey week to download now, or skip and sync later.
Find the city once with the device location, or choose it manually.

features.title: Choose the city
features.summary: Pick a state and a municipality; the choice drives prices, stations and the map.

steps.caption: The location picker lists the states; "Usar localização atual" detects the city instead.
Type part of the state name to filter the list.
After choosing the state, the municipalities appear in alphabetical sections.
Search the municipality by name and tap it.
The home screen now shows the city and the active survey week at the top.

features.title: Fuel prices in the city
features.summary: Read the ANP weekly average per fuel, sort the cards and switch to community prices.

steps.caption: Each card shows the ANP weekly average for a fuel, the number of surveyed stations and the source badge.
Scroll for diesel S500/S10, GNV and GLP (13 kg).
Shortcuts at the end of the list open the map, location, history, stations, vehicles and settings.
"Filtros" lets you order prices by average, lowest or highest.
With "Menor preço" each card shows the lowest surveyed price for that fuel.
The "Comunidade" toggle shows recent prices sent by drivers, kept apart from ANP data.

features.title: Stations, station page and route
features.summary: List surveyed stations for a fuel, search by name, open the station page, check ANP and community prices and start a route.

steps.caption: Tapping a fuel card opens the surveyed stations for that fuel, cheapest first.
Each station card shows the price, the brand, the public ANP address and the collection date.
Change the fuel from the selector at the top of the list.
Type part of a station name to filter the list.
The station page shows the name, brand, address and the main actions.
Choose a fuel chip; community prices (beta) and the ANP reference appear in separate cards.
The ANP reference price always shows the collection date and the survey week.
"Consultar análises de qualidade" lists ANP quality sampling for the station, with its limits.
"Rota e ir" asks for the device location the first time (Android system dialog).
Ratings and comments live in "Experiência dos motoristas"; this build shows the verification notice because station feedback is behind a feature flag.
"Sugerir correção" sends a name, address or permanent-closure correction for review.
"Entender como funciona" explains how a business can represent its station; it is not available in the beta.

features.title: Offline map download
features.summary: Download the offline map of the region so the map and routes work without internet.

steps.caption: Opening the map of a city without a pack offers "Baixar mapa de Mato Grosso"; tap "Baixar".
Downloads shows the total progress and each package (region, world base map, coastlines); Wi-Fi only by default.
When it finishes, the region pack is listed as active.
Back on the map, streets and stations render from the offline pack.

features.title: Map, station sheet and navigation
features.summary: Explore stations on the map, filter by source and service, open a station, save it and navigate with turn-by-turn guidance.

steps.caption: The map shows fuel stations (orange) and EV chargers (teal) of the chosen city.
"Filtros" chooses the city, the price source (ANP or community), the service (fuel or charging) and the product.
Tap a station to see its price with source, survey week and collection date.
"Salvar nos favoritos" keeps the station on this device.
"Rota e ir" draws the route from the current position with time and distance.
"Manobras" lists every turn before you leave.
"Iniciar navegação" starts offline turn-by-turn guidance with voice, zoom and recentre controls.
EV chargers come from open sources; the sheet says ANP has no electricity tariffs.

features.title: ANP survey weeks offline
features.summary: Download earlier ANP survey weeks to read them offline and switch the active week.

steps.caption: Tap the week chip at the top to open "Semana de pesquisa".
Each week shows when it was updated and whether it is downloaded; "Baixar" saves it offline.
The download imports the ANP data in place and can be cancelled.
Downloaded weeks are marked "Baixada".
Tapping a downloaded week makes it active: the chip and the ANP reference line change.

features.title: Price history
features.summary: Compare the ANP average of a fuel across the downloaded weeks.

steps.caption: "Histórico" charts the city average for each downloaded week, newest first.
Change the fuel from the selector.
Diesel S10 history for the same weeks.
Tap a bar to read that week's value.

features.title: Vehicles, tank-fill cost and fuel log
features.summary: Register up to three vehicles, see the cost to fill the tank, turn on price-drop alerts and log fill-ups.

steps.caption: "Veículos" starts empty; the + button adds a vehicle.
Give the vehicle a name, choose the propulsion and type the tank capacity in litres.
Choose the fuel and the price reference, and switch on "Avisar quando o preço cair" for a local price-drop alert.
The saved vehicle lists its fuel, tank size and price reference.
The home screen shows the cost to fill the tank at the cheapest surveyed station and a shortcut to go there.
"Lançamentos" keeps the vehicle's fill-ups and expenses on the device.
Record litres, full or partial tank, total paid and odometer.
The entry appears in the log, stored locally.

features.title: Settings
features.summary: Sync, automatic downloads, language, search distance, data retention, storage and account links.

steps.caption: Sync now, change the survey week and choose background sync and Wi-Fi-only rules.
Pick the app language and the radius of "Mais barato perto de mim".
Choose how many weeks of station data to keep and whether to keep the city's public directory offline.
See storage use, clear caches, open account and privacy, share the app and the official ANP page.

features.title: Profile and tools
features.summary: The Profile tab groups account, tools, references, Premium status and project contributors.

steps.caption: "Ferramentas e referências": games, company mode, vehicles, settings and contributions.
More tools: ANP history, surveyed stations, survey week, help and privacy.
Premium shows the plan status; paid purchase is disabled in this version and never affects trust.
"Contribuidores do projeto" lists approved contributor profiles.

features.title: Help, rules and privacy
features.summary: Community rules, reporting and appeals, privacy summary and the terms accepted on this device.

steps.caption: "Ajuda e regras da comunidade": how to contribute well, community rules, reports and appeals.
"Privacidade": full policy, web account deletion and the terms version accepted on this device.

features.title: Free account: create and delete
features.summary: Create a free account with only a username, see the signed-in profile and delete the account.

steps.caption: As a guest, Profile offers "Entrar ou criar conta gratuita"; browsing never needs an account.
After creating the account (username only, no email or password) Profile shows "Conectado".
After "Gerenciar conta → Excluir minha conta → Sim, excluir" the app returns to guest mode.

features.title: Driver hub
features.summary: Quick fuel and charging expenses, shifts and earnings for app drivers.

steps.caption: "Central do motorista" shows the vehicle in use, quick expense entries and work tracking (Premium gate shown).
"Turno e ganhos": start a shift with the odometer and record the day's net earnings.

context.knownIssue: Shift and earnings labels are hard-coded Portuguese in DriverWorkScreen.kt (not string resources).

features.title: Community tab
features.summary: Entry point for contributing prices, the forum and the community price feed.

steps.caption: "Comunidade" opens the price contribution, the Abastevo forum and the community price feed.
The feed filters by order and fuel; with no recent community price it invites a contribution.

features.title: Forum: read, comment, post and block
features.summary: Read editorial posts, filter by category, react and comment, write a topic and manage blocked users.

steps.caption: "Fórum Abastevo" lists posts with author, category and time; the pencil starts a new topic.
Category tabs filter the feed (fuels, e-mobility, traffic law…).
Open a post to read it in full.
At the end: comment, like, dislike, share and the live comment list.
Write a comment of up to 280 characters and tap "Publicar" (new comments go through moderation).
"Novo tópico": title, category and content.

context.knownIssue: Category chips show internal codes (FUELS, ELECTRIC, TRAFFIC_RULES) instead of translated labels.

steps.caption: Optional state, IBGE municipality, fuel and public name, then "Publicar tópico".

context.knownIssue: Fuel chips show internal codes (GASOLINE_REGULAR, GASOLINE_PREMIUM).

steps.caption: "Gerenciar conta → Usuários bloqueados" lists blocked people; they are not notified and can be unblocked any time.

features.title: Contribute a price with a photo
features.summary: Choose the station, photograph the price board, review the reading or type the price, and send it to the community queue.

steps.caption: "Colaborar com preço" first asks which station the price belongs to.
Search the station by name.
With the station selected, tap "Fotografar preço".
Android asks for camera permission the first time.
The phone camera opens; photograph only the price board. (Emulator test scene — not a price board.)
The photo is attached; crop to the frame or read it again. With no readable board the app asks you to type the prices.
Add the fuel, type the price (R$ 6,25) and tap "Enviar"; blank fuels are not sent.

context.knownIssue: Send button reads "Enviar 1 preços" (plural not handled).

steps.caption: "Minhas contribuições" tracks sends, queue and cancellations on this device only.

features.title: Offline games
features.summary: Two offline mini-games with local records only.

steps.caption: "Games": play offline, even without an account; records stay on the device.
Fuel Run and accessibility options: mute, reduce motion, save battery.
Each game explains how to play before "Começar".
End of a match with the score and the local record.

textOnlySteps.text: Type a username (3–20 letters and numbers, starting with a letter) and tap "Criar conta". The account screens are protected with FLAG_SECURE so the account key never appears in screenshots.
To delete: Profile → "Gerenciar conta" → "Excluir minha conta" → "Sim, excluir". This screen is FLAG_SECURE; the web path is /excluir-conta/.

On a topic or comment written by someone else, the ⋮ menu offers "Denunciar tópico", "Denunciar comentário", "Denunciar usuário" and "Bloquear usuário". Staging had only official editorial posts, which do not show the menu, so these dialogs were not captured.
"Modo empresa", "Entrar em uma empresa" and "Meus relatos privados" are FLAG_SECURE screens and are not captured.
